Dear ,
With very best wishes for a most wonderful birthday and year ahead.
Much love,
To the most special person in my life. You are my love, my heart and my joy. I cannot imagine my life without you.

Dear ,
Warmest wishes for a speedy recovery! Our thoughts are with you and we hope this brightens up your day.

Dear ,
Thank you for the memories of yesterday, for the happiness today, and the promise of all tomorrows! Happy Anniversary!

Dear ,
I'll never forgive myself...but I'm hoping you will. I'm sorry.

Dear ,
Please accept our condolences for your loss.
With deepest sympathy,
